method: Original push 0x18b7710, ordinary worker loop 0x18b7f80 (pop, tag handling, counter updates, empty-pop counter scan) and shutdown routine 0x18b7940 through its inlined exit-record push executed natively in Unicorn, single-threaded; memcpy 0x141c6afb0 runs natively. Supplied services: the event wait stub 0x143f45b93 (modeled as ret 8, scripted to inject records), the worker callback, the opaque non-returning routine 0x143e20621 at 0x18b80ee, and the per-worker notify stub 0x143f93753.
comparisons: all 0x728 dispatcher bytes (ring, four queue counters, both counter arrays, handles) after every case
service call order and arguments (wait handle and edx, callback token and caller flag, notify handle, fault index and value)
dispatcher counter and queue-counter snapshot at every callback invocation
return address, stack pointer and rax for push
state reached while spinning (full ring, unpublished prior writer) after a bounded native run
coverage: occupancies 0..41 records, arbitrary 32-bit counter origins including values near 2^32 and non-multiples of 24
records split across the end of the ring
consumer in flight (read published behind read claim) reducing push space
empty pops with all-zero and nonzero unclaimed counters
limits: Single-threaded only. No native concurrency evidence: every interleaving result lives in engine.pose_job_ring_model_check and is authored exploration.
Full ring and unpublished-writer states make native push spin forever; only that the native state reaches an unchanging spin and equals the model after a bounded run is checked.
Wait stub 0x143f45b93 and the notify stub are opaque; the stub is modeled as callee-cleanup of the pushed queue pointer, which the frame layout requires but was not decoded.
The routine called at 0x18b80ee when an empty pop sees a nonzero unclaimed counter is opaque and never returns in the model.
Worker slot values >= 32 excluded; later parts of the shutdown routine (0x18b7a6a onward) not executed.
Initial queue contents are built with the reconstructed push, which is separately validated by the push cases.
